translation: (In the depression on the shoulder, one cun and five fen before the large bone above the supraclavicular fossa.) Entering behind the shoulder, it joins Hand Taiyang and the Yang Qiao at Naoshu (SI10). (In the depression on the upper border of the scapula below the large bone behind the shoulder.) Ascending along behind the ear, it joins hand-foot Shaoyang at Fengchi (GB20). (In the depression in the hairline behind the ear.) Ascending to Naokong (one cun and a half behind Chengling, flanking the Yuzhen bone below, in the depression), Chengling (one cun and a half behind Zhengying), Zhengying (one cun behind Muchuang), Muchuang (one cun behind Linqi), Linqi.
